content.value: Show that the straight lines $\textstyle { \frac { x - 1 } { 2 } } = { \frac { y - 2 } { 3 } } = { \frac { z - 3 } { 4 } }$ and $\textstyle { \frac { x - 2 } { 3 } } = { \frac { y - 3 } { 4 } } = { \frac { z - 4 } { 5 } }$ are coplanar. Also find the equation of the plane containing them.
